item.text:
The blog posts page now fetches posts with `getPosts()` and displays each title and author. It uses Next.js `use cache` with the one-hour `hours` profile and the `posts` tag for on-demand invalidation. I also enabled Cache Components in [next.config.ts](/workspace/next.config.ts:3), which those APIs require.

The production build and TypeScript check passed. Next.js reported a one-hour revalidation period and included `posts` in the page’s cache tags.
